# freeipa_service_keytab_host (Resource)

Allows one FreeIPA host to create and retrieve the keytab of one existing service principal. The keytab material itself is never stored in Terraform state.





<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `host` (String) FreeIPA host FQDN allowed to create and retrieve this service keytab.
- `principal` (String) Canonical FreeIPA service principal.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
